source_goal_version.digest_input_policy: relative_path+sha256+state+role over generated files and witness statements

problem_context.problem_statement: Verify the real CRTOS CircularAreaRelease implementation under the corrected unified circular-area mixed backing resource. The function is called only with a valid nonnull descriptor, zeroes descriptor fields, frees the backing buffer, then frees the descriptor.
problem_context.expected_behavior: Consume any valid CircularAreaBackingResource, including mixed physical cells and either legal unequal-index status value, and return emp after freeing both allocations.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Input: one valid unified CircularAreaBackingResource. Output: emp. No null-input behavior is specified because the real C dereferences unconditionally.
spec_hint: Directly import the tracked common circular-area lib, not the callpoint-spec generated lib. Keep x_free data-buffer spec on UCharArray::mixed_full. Expand the unified backing resource only to feed both frees.
preferred_hidden_properties: Init success, Write success, Read success, Reset, and query-preserved resources can all be passed directly to Release without full-buffer conversion.

annotation_design_summary.case_lib_spec_changes: direct shared import only; no new mathematical definition
known_risks: The shared-resource expansion remains one manual entailment witness by design; it must be proved downstream rather than bypassed.
annotation_design_summary.mathematical_spec: For every state represented by CircularAreaBackingResource, including mixed physical cells and either legal unequal-index status, Release consumes the descriptor and backing-buffer allocations and returns emp.
preferred_hidden_properties_used: Every valid unified resource returned by Init, Read, Write, Reset, or a resource-preserving query is directly consumable by Release without a backing-buffer conversion.
